About Classic Reinsurance Brokers

Zimbabwe's premier reinsurance broker specializing in innovative and cost-effective reinsurance solutions across Africa and beyond.

Learn more Get in touch

Who We Are

Classic Reinsurance Brokers is a leading reinsurance intermediary in Zimbabwe, established with a commitment to excellence and innovation in the reinsurance sector.

We specialize in providing comprehensive reinsurance broking core products and services, complemented by professional advisory services tailored to the unique needs of insurance and reinsurance companies.

With a deep understanding of African markets and global reinsurance trends, we position our clients for sustainable growth and risk mitigation through strategic reinsurance placement and management.
